reviews.title: Adjustable and more accessible than I had thought!
reviews.text:
I impulse signed up at 2am and was kicking myself the next day for wasting money. 
I am disabled and have something similar to POTS. Even sitting with my legs down can make me woozy. 
I also have MCAS and exercise induced anaphylaxis (seemingly triggered when my heart rate gets too high). 
How am I going to use something like this? 

BUT I’m sitting here after my first workout and I think this might actually work out after all! It’s not too intense, but intense enough to work up a sweat and feel it in your muscles. I was worried it would be too much, but for me it is working okay! 
Granted today is a good health day, but maybe this app will help me have more good health days! 
The workouts seem very customizable! 

I would give it 5 stars so far, only I signed up on the website and on the app my weight was wrong. After adjusting it to the right starting weight it thinks I have gained 70+ pounds day one 💀

A little demotivating, but I track my eating on a different app so I will just track my weight there. 
Just wish you could adjust your starting weight after you sign up without it thinking you gained that. 

Thank you for making an app for those of us that can’t stand and dance! 
I have missed dancing SO FREAKING MUCH since my health declined, so hopefully your app can help me get that joy back. 

I will update again after I’ve been using the app for awhile ✌️

reviews.title: Extremely Misleading
reviews.text: Very misleading. I found this on Instagram and thought it was a good concept, but it’s more like a financial scam. They get you with an initial payment to “gain access”, but the majority of everything is locked and requires you to pay more money to access. They also offer other class types (hip hop, belly dance, twerking, etc), but those are also locked. The meal plan is beyond basic (try free chatGPT instead). I’m very happy they only got me out of $20 because I’d be EXTREMELY disappointed if I had paid more. Do yourself a favor and find something on YouTube for free and have ChatGPT make you a free meal plan. I’ve done both and I’m way happier.

reviews.title: So many things
reviews.text:
The idea is great…execution dismal. 
1. The picture /video come in blurry. 
2.  Getting it to open (the program) is a challenge in and of itself. However if you shut your I pad down you are able to get to your login.
3. Logging in…a hassle. You are sent a temporary password. I used it unsuccessfully several times. I eventually used my Apple ID to log in.
4.  Once logged in they ask for payment. That’s fine but I had already paid. I wasn’t about to pay again.
5.  Being unable to login I attempted to go to the site for help/guidance…don’t bother trying it is absolutely pointless.

I am extremely disappointed because the idea of what they are offering is beyond exciting. I can not work out normally because of my disability. I’m always looking for workouts that don’t scream senior citizen speed.
